identity.description: Ahrefs: SEO platform (site/keyword/backlink data) with a v3 REST API (api.ahrefs.com/v3) and a remote MCP server. Confirmed as the product named in the task.
identity.identity_notes: docs.ahrefs.com describes the Ahrefs API and MCP; the assignment hint ahrefs.com/api now redirects to docs.ahrefs.com.

auth.oauth_flows: Ahrefs Connect: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE; token exchange POST to https://ahrefs.com/oauth/token. Used for third-party apps acting for users.
auth.token_refresh: No refresh tokens; access tokens valid for 1 year, after which the user must re-authorize via OAuth.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes not documented in fetched sources. API keys can carry usage limits per key; OAuth-issued MCP keys are tagged with MCP scope and default to 200,000 API units per key.

access.production_restrictions: Ahrefs Connect (OAuth) app registration requires an Approval process where developers must demonstrate secure token handling. Remote MCP server is paid-plan only (Lite and up). Free accounts get only limited free test queries, and some endpoints (Rank Tracker, Management, Public) are free. API key creation is restricted to workspace owners and admins.

read_ops: Keyword, site, backlink, SERP, rank tracking, site audit and analytics data lookups across the listed tool groups (per API reference)
write_ops: Management tool is described only as project management; create/update/delete operations not established
api.rate_limits: Default 60 requests per minute per search summary; HTTP 429 when exceeded (not confirmed on a fetched page). API units consumed per request; base_cost 50 units per request per pricing-related source.
api.limitations: Breadth is read-focused and write operations are not established. Usage is metered in API units. The external MCP server is not a general-purpose programmatic API and custom scripts or standalone clients are not permitted. Legacy API v2 discontinued November 1, 2025 (per search summary).
